note: LilyGo T-Watch S3 Plus with the SX1262 radio, the all-in-one LayerTime target with the T-Watch Ultra's functionality. Drafted in S3 Plus Phase 0, before any hardware proof: every effective value is the DeviceCapabilities default and intent is in target. A field's effective value changes only when its status becomes verified on the watch. Hardware sources: LilyGoLib docs/hardware/lilygo-t-watch-s3-plus.md and schematic T_WATCH-S3 25-03-24.pdf at commit 38e6f8d; arduino-esp32 variants/lilygo_twatch_s3/pins_arduino.h.

displayClass.evidence: 1.3 in 240 x 240 ST7789V3 IPS TFT, 262K colours (LilyGo hardware doc). The contract has two display classes; ColorHighRes is the colour class. Whether 240 x 240 needs its own class is decided when the S3 Plus screens are built.

displayWidth.evidence: DISP_WIDTH 240 in variants/lilygo_twatch_s3/pins_arduino.h; LilyGo hardware doc

touch.evidence: FT6336U at 0x38 on Wire1, SDA 39 / SCL 40 / INT 16, reset not connected (LilyGo hardware doc)

buttons.evidence: A programmable PWR button (AXP2101) and GPIO0 exist (LilyGo hardware doc). The T-Ultra reads no button; the S3 Plus matches it until a feature needs one.

vibration.evidence: DRV2605 at 0x5A, enabled by AXP2101 BLDO2 (LilyGo hardware doc); LilyGoWatch2022::vibrator() in LilyGoLib src/LilyGoWatchS3.cpp

gps.evidence: u-blox MIA-M10Q or Quectel LS550G on UART1 RX 41 / TX 42, 38400 baud, PPS not connected (LilyGo hardware doc; LilyGoWatchS3.cpp initGPS). Which module this watch carries is read in Phase 1.

compass.evidence: No magnetometer: the sensor is a 3-axis BMA423 accelerometer (LilyGo hardware doc)

altitude.evidence: GNSS altitude, as on the T-Ultra. Proven with the GPS service.

nativeMaps.evidence: No platform cartography; LayerTime draws its own tiles

removableStorage.evidence: No SD card in LilyGo's feature table or pin map. Storage is the internal FFat partition (lilygo-s3plus/partitions.csv), which is not removable.

localWifiMonitor.evidence: ESP32-S3 promiscuous Wi-Fi, as on the T-Ultra. Proven in the Recon milestone.

localBleMonitor.evidence: NimBLE on the ESP32-S3, as on the T-Ultra. Proven in the Recon milestone, including the core 3.3.6 BLE gate.

externalRecon.evidence: All-in-one: Recon runs on the watch, not on a LayerWand

meshUi.evidence: Mesh is deferred until Recon is validated

localMeshtasticRadio.evidence: SX1262 on CS 5 / RST 8 / BUSY 7 / IRQ 9, LoRa rail AXP2101 ALDO4 (LilyGo hardware doc). Deferred; the TCXO voltage is unresolved (Meshtastic uses 1.8 V on this watch).

meshRadioShared.evidence: One SX1262 serves both mesh stacks, as on the T-Ultra

androidBridge.evidence: No Android companion in the all-in-one target
